title: Tender Executive
description:
Job Description Tender Executive (Mining & Water Treatment) Experience: 25 years
 Location: Visakhapatnam
 Department: Sales / Business Development / Tendering
 Reporting to: Business Head / Sales Head / Tendering Manager Job Summary The Tender Executive will be responsible for end-to-end tender management for the Mining and Water Treatment businesses, covering both Government and Private sector opportunities, including GeM bids and Reverse Auctions (RA). The role involves identifying relevant tenders, analysing tender documents, preparing techno-commercial bids, coordinating internal inputs, ensuring timely and compliant online submissions, and following up through bid evaluation and award stages. The incumbent will work closely with Sales, Technical, Finance, Logistics, Legal, and Business Unit heads to ensure accurate, competitive, and compliant bid submissions within prescribed timelines. Key Responsibilities Tender Identification & Tracking Identify and track relevant tender opportunities from GeM, CPPP, State e-procurement portals, PSU portals, private customer procurement portals, SAP Ariba, Procol, and other e-tendering platforms. Conduct daily and periodic searches for new tenders based on product categories, customer segments, past tender release dates, and business priorities. Maintain a centralised Tender Calendar / Tender Tracker covering tender publication dates, pre-bid meeting dates, clarification deadlines, submission deadlines, bid opening dates, and follow-up requirements. Share a daily/weekly pipeline of identified opportunities with the respective Business Unit heads and sales team. Review tender notifications, corrigenda, amendments, addenda, and pre-bid meeting notices; ensure timely internal communication and action. Tender Analysis & Synopsis Preparation Carefully read and interpret tender documents, including eligibility criteria, scope of supply, technical specifications, commercial terms, payment terms, delivery schedules, EMD/BG requirements, liquidated damages, arbitration clauses, and compliance requirements. Prepare a concise Tender Synopsis / Bid Assessment Note for each opportunity, highlighting scope, customer, location, eligibility, submission deadline, key risks, documentation requirements, pricing inputs required, and recommended go/no-go decision. Coordinate with respective BU heads, product managers, and technical teams for feasibility assessment, product selection, technical compliance, and bid strategy. Maintain a database of past tenders, customer requirements, technical specifications, pricing trends, competitor information, and bid outcomes for future reference and analysis. Bid Preparation & Submission Prepare complete techno-commercial bid documents, including technical offers, compliance statements, deviation statements, product data sheets, MSDS, test certificates, manufacturing licences, quality certificates, past performance references, and other supporting documents. Prepare price quotations, bill of quantities (BOQ), commercial offers, cost sheets, and final bid price in coordination with Sales, Finance, and Business Unit heads. Ensure all bid documents are accurate, complete, properly formatted, digitally signed, and uploaded as per the tender requirements. Submit bids through GeM, SAP Ariba, Procol, CPPP, State e-procurement portals, and customer-specific procurement platforms within the stipulated deadline. Manage online bidding processes, including participation in Reverse Auctions (RA), price revisions, bid tracking, and real-time coordination during auction events. Ensure timely response to tender clarifications, queries, corrigenda, and additional document requests raised before or after bid submission. Documentation, Compliance & Registrations Maintain and update company registrations, vendor registrations, digital signatures, GeM seller profile, product catalogues, certifications, licences, GST details, PAN, MSME/Udyam registration, and other statutory/compliance documents. Manage EMD, tender fees, bid security, bank guarantees, performance guarantees, and related documentation in coordination with Finance and Treasury teams. Ensure timely renewal of expiring documents, certificates, registrations, and bank guarantees. Maintain a well-organised repository of tender documents, submitted bids, technical data, certificates, customer correspondence, and award/rejection records. Cross-Functional Coordination Coordinate with Sales, Technical, R&D, Application, Finance, Logistics, Legal, Quality, and Supply Chain teams for timely collection of bid inputs. Follow up with internal stakeholders for pricing approvals, technical clarifications, sample/test requirements, delivery commitments, and authorisation letters. Coordinate with customers, government departments, PSUs, and procurement teams for clarification meetings, pre-bid discussions, document submissions, and tender-related communication. Support Sales and BU teams during bid presentations, technical clarifications, negotiations, and post-bid discussions. Post-Submission Follow-Up Track bid status after submission, including technical evaluation, commercial evaluation, shortlisting, L1 status, negotiations, purchase orders, and award/rejection notifications. Follow up on pending approvals, clarifications, purchase orders, contract formalities, and post-award documentation. Inform relevant stakeholders promptly about bid results, award status, and lessons learned. Support handover of awarded orders to Sales, Operations, Finance, and Logistics teams for execution. Reporting & MIS Prepare periodic MIS reports on tenders identified, bids submitted, win/loss analysis, conversion ratio, tender pipeline, upcoming deadlines, and pending actions. Maintain records of tender fees, EMD/BG outstanding, bid success rate, customer-wise performance, and product-wise tender participation. Provide insights on pricing trends, competitor participation, recurring tender opportunities, and improvement areas in bid quality and compliance. Key Deliverables Daily/weekly tender opportunity pipeline. Tender calendar and submission tracker. Tender synopsis and bid assessment notes for each opportunity. Complete and compliant techno-commercial bids submitted on time. Updated vendor registrations, certifications, and compliance documents. Reverse auction participation and price strategy support. Tender MIS, win/loss analysis, and periodic management reports. Timely follow-up on clarifications, corrigenda, bid status, and awards. Required Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of Government and Private sector tendering processes. Hands-on experience with GeM, CPPP, State e-procurement portals, SAP Ariba, Procol, and other e-tendering platforms. Understanding of Reverse Auction (RA), EMD, Bank Guarantee, L1, technical/commercial evaluation, and public procurement processes. Excellent reading, interpretation, and analytical skills for tender documents. Strong documentation, formatting, and attention to detail. Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, PDF editing, and digital signature processes. Good communication, coordination, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work under strict deadlines and manage multiple tenders simultaneously. Basic understanding of mining, mineral processing, water treatment chemicals, flocculants, polymers, and industrial specialty chemicals will be an added advantage. Familiarity with tender-related commercial terms, payment terms, delivery terms, taxation, and compliance documentation. Educational Qualification Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Engineering, Science, or a related discipline. Postgraduate qualification or certification in supply chain, procurement, or tender management will be an added advantage. Preferred Experience 2–5 years of experience in tender management, e-procurement, bid preparation, sales support, or business development. Experience in mining, minerals, water treatment, chemicals, industrial products, or B2B industrial sales will be preferred. Prior exposure to GeM bids, reverse auctions, PSU tenders, and private-sector e-procurement portals is highly desirable. GeM supports multiple procurement modes, including direct purchase, bidding, and reverse auction.[gem.gov]
